text:
Alex: Heads-up — we need to schedule a k6/locust traffic replay + 12h soak for the inference runtime. Goal: catch memory leaks, KV cache degradation, and any perf regressions after the last kernel swap. Suggested window: Friday 0100–1300 UTC. Can folks confirm availability and constraints?

Maya: Friday window works for me. I'll own the k6 script updates (adding weighted user journeys + DELETE path error cases). Estimated 30m prep.

Jun: I can handle the traffic replay mapping from prod traces. Reminder: we should strip PII and reduce trace retention. I'll send the sanitized replay bundle to S3: s3://redwood-internal/replays/176200.

Priya: Oncall here — fine with Friday, but we need a clear escalation runbook. If p95 latency > 800ms for >5m, auto-roll back to previous model variant. Add an incident channel notify.

Ben: Infra note: we'll need extra ephemeral GPU nodes for the peak phase (estimated 200k tokens/sec). I'll request a reserved burst group and pre-warm the node pool. Also toggle telemetry to detailed mode for the soak.

Alex: Good — Maya can you include a warmup ramp for KV cache (simulate prefix hits) and a phase with many short sequences? That was where we saw regressions last month.

Maya: Yep. Plan in k6: 10m ramp, 2h steady at baseline RPS, 4h peak (peak = baseline*3), 6h low steady. I'll attach the JS snippet after prep. Example ramp command: `k6 run --vus 100 --duration 10m script.js`.

Jun: For replay fidelity I'll include user-agent sharding and token-length distribution histogram. Also adding header `x-replay-id: 1762003456` so logs filter easy.

Priya: Add a safety flag `--canary-only` to constrain to one AZ for the first 30m. If green, we flip to cross-AZ. Prevents noisy blast radius.

Ben: We'll set autoscale floor to N+2 GPUs for the test and enable GC logging. Also will export `nvidia_smi` snapshots every 5m to CloudWatch.

Alex: Good. Let's also run a targeted perf profiler at 2h and 8h marks to capture CPU/CUDA hotspots. Maya/Jun — can you coordinate the profiler artifact names and upload paths?

Maya: I'll push profiler hooks to the k6 script that hit /debug/profile-start and /debug/profile-stop endpoints. Artifacts go to s3://redwood-internal/profiles/176200/.

Jun: I'll add a small Locust job for stateful sessions to cross-check k6 stateless replay. Locust file will be under the same replay bundle.

Priya: Quick checklist for oncall: 1) Pager rule for 500s and p99>1500ms, 2) Rollback playbook link: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/rollback, 3) Contact list pinned.

Alex: Thanks. Who will kick off? I can if everyone is ok — otherwise assign. Also please ping reviewers for the perf-regress job: @Maya @Ben @Jun.

Maya: I'll kick off prep on Thursday 22:00 UTC, run a dry replay against staging, and post the k6/locust command lines in this thread.

Ben: I'll provision infra at Thu 23:30 UTC and run a warm-up scale test.

Jun: Dry run looks good. One ask: add header sampling so we can replay errors separately. I'll include a filter.

Priya: I'll be online for the first 3 hours Friday and reachable on call. Adding the incident channel: #incident-runtime-soak and enabling bot notifications.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: canary variant -> runtime-test-cluster at 2026-03-20T01:00:00Z. Change ID: prod-swap-176200.

Alex: Perfect. Action items summarized: Maya (k6 updates + profiler hooks), Jun (trace sanitization + locust), Ben (infra + telemetry), Priya (oncall/runbook), Alex (kickoff coordination + rollback authority). We'll reconvene Friday 00:30 UTC in the thread for a final thumbs-up. :thumbsup:
